title: Decentralized Synthetic Stablecoin
tagline: Over-collateralized synthetic asset protocol with dynamic debt pooling.
description: An algorithmic stablecoin system inspired by Synthetix. Features include multi-collateral backing, a global debt pool for liquidity, and Chainlink-powered price feeds to maintain peg stability and system solvency.

title: Dominix Token Launchpad
tagline: A secure ICO platform for decentralized token fundraising.
description: A high-performance fundraising engine featuring multi-tiered token presales, automated whitelisting, and dynamic pricing tiers. The platform handles secure asset exchange, token vesting schedules, and provides a seamless user interface for early-stage investors.

title: Protocol Security Audit: Rarity Town
tagline: Comprehensive vulnerability assessment and security hardening.
description: A deep-dive security audit of the Rarity Town NFT protocol. Performed manual code review and automated analysis to identify high-severity vulnerabilities. Implemented a robust testing suite including Fuzzing and Invariant testing to ensure protocol-level safety and reentrancy resistance.
